verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a public Create Campaign endpoint in its API reference, and states that the platform is accessible headlessly through its public APIs. That covers the creation half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a documented API endpoint to schedule or send a campaign; the pricing-page 'Schedule recurring tasks' line is not tied to the API. missing for 10: documented campaign schedule/send endpoint, evidence that the full create-to-send flow works without the dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Creates a campaign given a set of parameters, then returns it.
Klaviyo is also accessible headlessly — through its public APIs and MCP server — so people and AI agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data from outside the Klaviyo interface.
